summary_units.summary: AS114206 HD in Rehabilitation Services AS114206J HHS3190M Human Physiology and Functional Anatomy for Rehabilitation Services HHS3190MJ Semester 1 (26-27) Scheme of Module Activity Outline ▪ Module Intended Learning Outcomes (MILO) ▪ Module Assessment Plan ▪ Lesson Plan Module Intended Learning Outcomes (MILO) On completion of this module, learners are expected to be able to: 1.
